title: Alaska Airlines’ support for those impacted by the Spokane Complex Fire
summary: The Spokane Complex Fire is one of the most destructive in Washington’s history. Here’s how Alaska has helped the impacted communities and ongoing relief efforts.
body_markdown:



Alaska Airlines has donated $25,000 to the Innovia Foundation and $25,000 to Northwest Harvest to help communities recover from the Spokane Complex Fire, one of the most destructive wildfires in Washington history.





The company also supports disaster response efforts year-round as a member of the American Red Cross Ready 365 Giving Program and through[the Alaska Airlines Disaster Relief Pool](https://www.alaskaair.com/atmosrewards/content/buy-share-gift-points/donate?_gl=1*ktu91r*_gcl_aw*R0NMLjE3ODQ5MjgyNzIuQ2p3S0NBandtb3pUQmhBZUVpd0FrRUdaenBCM21YU1h6bU5MWXM2RzVwOTlYRmJ4Uk5VZkg3bzdwajNjcGtJdlNXVnEyNU1CZlpwWFhSb0MydllRQXZEX0J3RQ..*_gcl_dc*R0NMLjE3ODQ5MjgyNzIuQ2p3S0NBandtb3pUQmhBZUVpd0FrRUdaenBCM21YU1h6bU5MWXM2RzVwOTlYRmJ4Uk5VZkg3bzdwajNjcGtJdlNXVnEyNU1CZlpwWFhSb0MydllRQXZEX0J3RQ..*_gcl_au*MTE5NTQ0Mzg1NC4xNzgwNTA3ODI2*_ga*NTkxNTAx*_ga_S6FNN1RWRJ*czE3ODY0MDg5NDAkbzE4MiRnMSR0MTc4NjQwODk1NyRqNDMkbDAkaDY4NzYyOTM2Nw..) , a special fund under Atmos Giving.
